metadata.title: Leopard Print Pop Diva Album Layout

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic layout featuring a full-bleed leopard print background framing a central square photographic portrait. The design uses bold, yellow serif typography at the top and white italicized serif text at the bottom, creating a layered 'frame-within-a-frame' effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square photograph anchored against a busy organic pattern
Large-scale yellow display type contrasting with the dark leopard spots
Italicized white body text balancing the heavy header weight
Drop shadow on the central image creating depth against the flat pattern
coreInvariants: Leopard print texture as the primary background
Square inset for the main subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central square portrait occupying approximately 50% of the vertical height, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow header text at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Header -> Subtitle -> Central Image -> Bottom Tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the leopard print fills all areas not occupied by the central image or text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and blacks (leopard pattern) providing a neutral but busy base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for primary display text to ensure legibility against the pattern.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for secondary text and highlights within the central photo.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow text and central subject's clothing (feathers) against a muted, earthy background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning in the main header to create a solid block of color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold display serif paired with its lighter, italicized weight for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Hard-edged square frame for the inset photo
Heavy black drop shadow behind the inset photo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, fashion-forward look of the era.
Appropriate for the secondary text's clarity and classic feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-bleed leopard print pattern with organic, irregular black spots on a tan and brown gradient background. Place a square white placeholder in the center with a distinct black drop shadow falling to the bottom right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold yellow serif text in all caps at the top. Add three lines of centered, white, italicized serif text in all caps at the bottom, using wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the leopard print consistent across the background?
Is the yellow text clearly legible against the pattern?
Does the central square have a visible drop shadow?
Is the bottom text italicized and centered?

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text has a subtle shadow to pop from the pattern.
Check that the central square is perfectly centered.
Verify the leopard pattern looks like a textile or fur, not a digital noise.
Confirm the bottom text is white and uses an italic serif font.
recipe.reuseFormula: Leopard Print Background + Central Square Inset + Bold Yellow Serif Header + Wide-Tracked White Italic Footer.
